title: Mechanical Supervisor
description:
*JOB DESCRIPTION *
Responsible for /ensure:

  • All relevant governing documents are adhered to by direct reports.
  • All relevant governing documents are revised as and when required.
  • That clear daily guidelines are provided to all direct reports.
  • Visible leadership by spending time in the field and monitoring daily operations.
  • Required logbooks are maintained and updated as per requirements.
  • Thorough handovers are provided at each daily change of shift.
  • Subordinates are trained to fill higher positions .

Other duties are performed as required and/or directed by his/her direct supervisor.
EQUIPMENT & SYSTEMS
Responsible For /ensure:

  • Operational preparedness of all safety and emergency equipment.
  • That all relevant equipment is maintained and maintenance is recorded.
  • Sufficient stock of spare parts and materials required is maintained.

*Responsabilities
RESPONSIBILITIES *

  • Ensure effective use of the Company's Maintenance Management System.
  • Ensure that personnel complete tasks in a safe and efficient manner and comply with all Company policies and regulatory laws and regulations.
  • Assist in planning and coordinating all preventative and corrective maintenance activities in conjunction with other department heads.
  • Assists the Technical Section Leader with all certificates for Class, Flag State and regulatory body requirements.
  • Work with Technical Section Leader and other supervisors to coordinate daily work activities accordingly.
  • Assist the Technical Section Leader to ensure that all Third Party equipment is fit for purpose, certified,
  • correctly installed and maintained while on the rig.
  • Ensure that reports for repair and maintenance of equipment are accurate and complete.
  • Ensure that the permit to work and isolation systems are strictly adhered to by the maintenance department.
  • Assist the drilling department with repair and maintenance of drilling equipment as required.
  • Perform maintenance of all the unit's systems including the piping system according to the maintenance program.
  • Assist the electrical department with repair and maintenance of electrical equipment as required.
  • Ensure technical inventory is maintained within budget and at operating levels.
  • Ensure equipment is maintained as per Seadrill and manufacturer's specifications.
  • Assist other departments to ensure first line maintenance is performed effectively.
  • Develop and promote effective troubleshooting condition evaluation and root cause failure analysis programs for all technical equipment.
  • Promote and develop maintenance task optimization and provide feedback to technical team. Follow up and implement approved changed to SAMS.
  • Maintain a working relationship with the Client representatives.
  • Perform or lead incident investigation as required.
  • Ensure technical inventory is maintained within budget and at operating levels
  • Assist with coordinating management of change for design modification of equipment and within technical area;
  • Liaise with shore based technical staff to ensure a timely transfer of knowledge within the fleet.
  • Liaise with the marine department regarding the loading, ordering and use of fuel, lubes, potable water and drill water.
  • Assist with classification surveys as part of continuous machinery survey and any other applicable requirements.
  • Assist Technical Section Leader with budget preparation.
  • Mentor, develop and train crew members to ensure they are competent to work in their current job positions and where appropriate coached and prepared for the next position.
  • Ensure that approved rig operating procedures are adhered to at all times. Report all unsafe activities, situations, and potential hazards to supervisor.
  • Actively participate in safety, departmental, pre-tour, client meetings, etc.
  • Actively participate in the Safety Management Systems.
  • Ensure housekeeping is maintained in assigned areas.
  • Effectively use all safety and environmental tools employed by Seadrill (5-point check, STAR cards, PTW etc.).
  • Perform all emergency duties as per designation on the station bill and emergency response plans.
  • Comply with the training matrix for the position.
  • Comply with the Competence Assurance Program in a timely manner as per Seadrill requirement.
  • Conduct performance appraisals for subordinates. Recommend promotion, development or disciplinary action.
  • Follow maintenance policy as specified by the Company at all times.
  • Review and, as required, perform all safety control duties as per rig´s specific HSE Case, Safety Case, HAZOP and TBRA´s.
  • Review and, as required, perform all duties related to safety controls among all tasks performed by himself and or working group.
  • Perform, respecting any applicable license limitation and under supervision, similar responsibilities as the Technical Leader, Engine Room Operator or Assistant Technical Section Leader for training, qualification and temporary coverage purposes.
  • Perform, if required, the same duties as senior mechanic.

*QUALIFICATIONS *
As per Seadrill training and competence directives.

*Minimum Requirements For The Role: *

  • Be able to communicate both in Portuguese and English
  • High School Technical diploma in Mechanic with professional register valid (CFT Ativo)
  • Previous experience within the function
  • Previous experience in Drilling Companies
  • Valid certificates: CBSP, THUET, NR13, etc.

SAFETY AT SEADRILL
Our goal is to ensure that 'nobody gets hurt' whilst performing their job. Everyone at Seadrill has a part to play in meeting our safety commitment.

Through strong leadership and personal responsibility from all employees, we take a systematic approach to identifying, managing and preventing the hazards involved in our day to day operations.

Nothing is more important to us than the health, safety and security of our workforce and the communities in which we operate and behaving responsibly towards our shared environment. We are vigilant, disciplined and always looking out for one another. Everyone at Seadrill is accountable for helping to build this culture of care. This includes:

  • The standard for tidiness and cleanness is adhered to.

In Seadrill, Setting The Standard Is Not Just About What We Deliver, But How We Deliver It. description:
Company Description

Portuguese Bilingual | Social Media | Customer Service | Community Manager | Global team | Remote | Brazil

BE PART OF OUR GLOBAL TEAM AND MAKE AN IMPACT HERE AT BRICKBRANDS     

BrickBrands is in the business of providing 24/7 brand protection, positive brand sentiment and overall increased customer engagement in various languages and cultures.

BrickBrands is a fast-growing company offering a lot of opportunities and valuable learning experiences that open doors for talented individuals to be a part of our global team. We embrace and promote diversity and inclusivity, the first step in building better relationships and conversations. Thus BrickBrands is always on the lookout for self-starters with the passion to excel and to join us in our mission: Create opportunities for brands and communities to speak.

Job Description

Summary of the Role

As a Social-First Customer Care Specialist, you will be the first point of contact for users across social channels (public comments and DMs) and email. You'll support customers of a leading digital subscription-based product suite and help maintain a positive brand presence by responding to customer questions, resolving issues, and escalating when needed.

This role is ideal for someone who's quick, calm under pressure, great with people, and comfortable supporting users with account access, subscriptions, billing, and product-related troubleshooting in a highly visible environment.

What You'll Do
You'll be the frontline voice of the brand across social, helping customers in real time while keeping responses human, clear, and platform-native.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Responding to public comments with strong judgment, context awareness, and the right brand tone
  • Managing direct messages (DMs) and private support conversations end-to-end
  • Using a CRM to review customer history, track cases, and document outcomes clearly
  • Supporting common customer service needs including:
    • Account and login support
    • Subscription, billing, refunds, and cancellations
    • Retention-style conversations (when appropriate)
    • Access, download, install, or "it's not working" troubleshooting
  • Providing basic product guidance and technical triage, escalating when needed
  • Using AI-assisted drafting tools to respond faster while ensuring every message is accurate, empathetic, and safe before sending
  • Following established escalation paths for high-risk issues, sensitive topics, and VIP situations
  • Contributing to consistent quality across shifts (tone, accuracy, decision-making)

Qualifications

Here's What You Will Need:

  • A High School Diploma or equivalent
  • 2+ years of experience in social care, community management, CX support, or digital customer service
  • Strong verbal communication & writing skills (friendly, clear, and socially native)
  • Comfort handling customer issues like billing, subscriptions, access problems, and troubleshooting
  • Calm under pressure and confident in high-visibility comment sections
  • Organized, accountable, and consistent 
  • Fluent in English both written and oral
  • General knowledge and interest in various social media platforms  
  • A good working home environment with a stable internet connection
  • The ability to work an 8-hour shift on a rotating shift schedule

Nice to have:

  • Near native Fluency in Portuguese, Spanish or French
  • Familiarity with creative or technical digital products (design, photo/video editing, productivity tools, generative AI tools)
  • Experience working within a CRM, or social tools such as Sprout, Sprinklr etc. 
  • Experience supporting subscription-based or SaaS products
  • Experience with moderation and customer engagement in high-volume social environments

Additional Information

The Perks BrickBrands Offers:

  • 100% Remote position
  • Continuous learning experience & career growth opportunities
  • Offers competitive compensation based on location market rates
  • A great opportunity to work with some of the world's coolest and most innovative brands
  • A welcoming environment where even your feedback and suggestions are all being taken into consideration
  • Enjoy working in a diverse & global team environment - BrickBrands team members come from different backgrounds

Interested to work in social media that is focused on customer care, while working remotely from home with a global team? Send your CV in ENGLISH.

description:

Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market-leading business segments. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward Making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

As a Senior Front-End and System Engineer - Tendering & FEED, you will be responsible for:

  • Defining and preparing functional specifications for subsea system components such as trees, controls, manifolds, wellhead connections, and flowlines.

Fuel your passion

  • Have 7+ years of experience with engineering processes, methods, and project execution practices
  • Have knowledge of the Subsea Systems Engineering lifecycle, including NPI, tendering, project engineering, SIT, commissioning, and operations.

We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Result of Service

The Administrative Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Expected duration

2 months, with the possibility of renewal

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners, for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. UN-Habitat and the Instituto Pereira Passos/Municipality of Rio de Janeiro have a longstanding collaboration and are currently implementing the Social Territories Programme in the city. To support the effective implementation of this initiative, the UN-Habitat Office in Rio de Janeiro is looking for an Administrative Assistant. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Administrative Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Administrative Assistant will support the implementation of the programme and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Provide administrative support to implement project-related activities. b) Support the project team's communication with local counterparts and partners, such as local governments, civil society organizations, universities, private sector, etc. c) Support the adequate execution of technical and/or administrative activities of the project, under the guidelines of immediate supervisor. d) Organize project meetings and document group meetings, forums, consultations, training events and other activities related to project planning, development, and implementation. e) Support in the collection of data, legislation and other documents in the municipal offices and archives. f) Organize and archive all documents and information relevant to project administration. g) Support the receipt and distribution of correspondence, materials, and equipment. h) Support the team through audits and other administrative and financial compliance checks. i) Maintain and update office inventory. j) Request quotes for low-value acquisitions. k) Write official letters in Portuguese. l) Support the selection processes of technical and/or field personnel, schedule and organize interview panels, contact shortlisted candidates for interviews and provide post-interview feedback if necessary. m) Assist in receiving monthly reports from consultants and/or field staff, including the procedures necessary for the monthly payroll. n) Assist in the organization of events (in-person or online), including registration forms, attendance lists, issuing certificates, booking venues and coffee breaks, and other necessary operational activities. o) Assist with travel requests for the technical team, including travel requests and mission reports. p) Be responsible for keeping information organized and accessible. q) Carry out specific activities and other tasks that may be requested by the supervisor. r) Support other administrative functions as requested by the UN-Habitat operational team in Rio de Janeiro. s) Participate in missions as requested. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Administrative Assistant will support the implementation of a project in partnership with the above-mentioned institution. The Administrative Assistant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil of monthly activities' report.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Administration, International Relations, Public Management or related fields, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
• Minimum two (2) years of experience in administrative, secretarial, project management, operational and/or human resources activities is required.
• Professional experience with local governments and/or civil society and advocacy initiatives is desirable.
• Previous experience in the United Nations System is desirable.
• Familiarity with and interest in urban development and climate issues as well as the Organization's global urban agenda is desirable. Skills:
• Proficiency in Office Package (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook) is required.
• Mastery of technological tools and use of software and online platforms is required.
• Mastery of online event and conference tools is desirable.
• Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

  • Collaborating cross-functionally to identify customer pain points and provide product improvement recommendations to ensure a "magical" customer experience.

The Team You'll Join


You will be the first service provider post-sale, joining a high-growth environment where you will eventually lead a team of Support Analysts and Specialists. You will work closely with product, engineering, and internal implementations leaders to constantly improve the onboarding experience and service models for new customer types.

About You

  • Communication: Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to articulate complex concepts clearly.

  • Adaptability: Flexible, resilient, and comfortable dealing with uncertainties or ambiguous situations.
  • Leadership Traits: Proactive, ambitious, and a self-starter who takes ownership and empowers teammates to improve.
  • Experience (Plus): Knowledge of finance and accounting, or experience working at a high-growth software company.

title: Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world's best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez's Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people's lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do


You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a Retention Marketing Specialist within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

Requirements


What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like


Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

Up to 40 hours weekly

VENHA TRABALHAR COM A GENTE

Em 2017, nascemos com um propósito:
ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil.
Desde então, nos consolidamos como uma das principais empresas do setor no país e estamos presentes em seis estados brasileiros (Alagoas, Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro e Sergipe), beneficiando milhões de pessoas por meio de nossas concessões e parcerias público-privadas. Atuamos com o compromisso de proporcionar mais qualidade de vida e saúde à população atendida, por meio de um trabalho responsável e de excelência no fornecimento de água tratada e nos serviços de coleta, afastamento e tratamento de esgoto.

Mais do que uma atividade empresarial, encaramos a universalização do saneamento básico como um compromisso de larga escala com a vida, com as pessoas, com o meio ambiente, com nossos parceiros e com o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil. Esse propósito guia nossas decisões e reforça, todos os dias, o nosso compromisso em cada gota.

O nosso jeito de ser é marcado por um DNA inovador, que promove um ambiente acolhedor, respeitoso e repleto de aprendizados, gerando impacto positivo na sociedade. A valorização e o respeito às diferenças fazem parte da nossa cultura, promovendo uma atuação ética, inclusiva e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro para mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas negras, pessoas LGBTQIA+, independentemente de crenças, idade ou qualquer outro marcador social ou identitário. Buscamos equidade e respeito em nossas equipes e acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação. Já somos mais de
2.800 colaboradores
e seguimos com perspectivas de ir ainda mais longe.

Você já se perguntou qual é o seu propósito e que história deseja escrever para a sua vida e carreira? Sempre sonhou em ter um papel protagonista e impactar positivamente a vida de milhares de pessoas? Aqui, você pode fazer parte dessa transformação.

Vamos construir um futuro melhor, Iguá Saneamento.

Ensino superior completo em engenharia.

Experiência com manutenção de grande porte

Your differences drive our performance

At Air Liquide, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, which means that, regardless of your gender identity, sexual orientation, color, age, religion, nationality or disability, we value a work environment made up of true stories, built by true people.

Somos a BONI, uma distribuidora de materiais de construção sediada no Rio de Janeiro, nascida com o propósito de servir. Nossa atuação se destaca no mercado, principalmente pelas sólidas parcerias comerciais e pela qualidade dos nossos serviços.

Ao longo dos anos, ampliamos nossa oferta de produtos, e hoje possuímos mais de 20 departamentos, garantindo que nossos clientes encontrem tudo o que precisam em um só lugar. Com um estoque robusto de mais de 9.500 itens, nossa equipe comercial está sempre pronta para atender às demandas do mercado com agilidade e eficiência.

Trabalhamos com mais de 270 marcas renomadas, cuidadosamente selecionadas para garantir a melhor qualidade e variedade aos nossos clientes. Essas parcerias com marcas de prestígio nos permitem oferecer produtos confiáveis, certificados e inovadores, que atendem às mais diversas necessidades do setor de construção.

Nosso compromisso com a excelência se estende à nossa logística. Com uma área de armazenagem de 14.000m², operamos com um alto nível de organização e capacidade de resposta. Nossa operação eficiente e bem estruturada nos permite atender todo o estado do Rio de Janeiro, garantindo que nossos clientes recebam seus pedidos de forma rápida e segura. Nossa equipe dedicada e altamente capacitada está sempre pronta para oferecer um serviço de alta qualidade, priorizando a satisfação dos nossos clientes em cada etapa do processo.

Na BONI, acreditamos que construir parcerias sólidas é fundamental para o sucesso. Por isso, trabalhamos diariamente para entregar qualidade em tudo o que fazemos.

Descrição do Cargo
Estamos em busca de um profissional para o cargo de auxiliar de conferente na Nova Boni, localizado em Rio de Janeiro, RJ. As principais atividades incluem a conferência de produtos e mercadorias, separação, organização do estoque, arrumação dos materiais e controle de entrada e saída de itens. Será responsável por verificar a integridade e a conformidade das mercadorias, assegurando que estejam de acordo com os pedidos. Este é um cargo presencial.

Qualificações

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes:
    Habilidade em realizar conferências com precisão e organizar materiais de forma eficiente.

title: IT Support Technician
description:
IT Support Technician

  • Located in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Full Time Position, Monday - Friday

The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The IT Support Technician provides basic technical support to the Brazil business unit. This role focuses on assisting with day-to-day IT operations, including troubleshooting hardware and software issues, supporting user access, and maintaining system functionality. The position works under the guidance of senior IT staff and collaborates with local teams to ensure smooth IT operations. The role reports directly to the Director of IT and maintains a functional reporting line to the Operations Manager.

Tasks:

  1. Perform basic troubleshooting with the ability to resolve common hardware and software issues for desktops, laptops, printers, and peripheral devices.
  2. Provide user support by assisting with password resets, account lockouts, and VPN connectivity issues.
  3. Monitor system performance and report issues to senior IT staff and via applicable Remedy Ticket Systems.
  4. Assist with software installations and updates of standard applications under supervision.
  5. Provide inventory & setup by preparing new workstations and ensuring proper configuration.
  6. Maintain records of support requests and resolutions.
  7. Perform simple maintenance tasks like cleaning equipment and checking cables.

Skills:

  • Proficient oral and written communication skills in both Portuguese and English.
  • Basic knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (IP addresses, Wi-Fi setup).
  • Ability to follow instructions and escalate complex issues.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This role does not include supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment:

This position is based in a professional office setting and involves regular use of standard office equipment, including computers and phones. Additionally, the role may occasionally require interaction with enterprise-grade IT and infrastructure systems such as firewalls, network switches, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), and both copper and fiber optic network cabling under the supervision of Senior IT staff.

Physical Demands:

This is an active, hands-on role that requires the IT Support Technician to spend a significant portion of the day standing and moving. The position may involve short bursts of physically demanding activity, such as lifting and relocating computer equipment or navigating stairs. On occasion, tasks may require working in confined or elevated spaces, including under raised computer room floors or above drop ceilings.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is a full-time role, and as such, the IT Support Technician is eligible to participate in the regional benefits program available to Katalyst employees.

Core working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Additional hours, including occasional night, weekend, and holiday work, may be required to fulfill job responsibilities and support operational needs.

Travel:

Occasional travel may be necessary. Mileage for offsite meetings or errands will be reimbursed at the current regional rate. Travel will mostly be within the Rio De Janeiro area visiting client and 3
rd
 party sites to service our equipment located at those sites.

Required Education and Experience

  • Certificate of Completion of Secondary Education
  • IT-related coursework, professional training, or industry certifications preferred.
  • Experience of up to 2 years in IT support, system administration, or networking (including internships or technical school experience).
  • Working proficiency in English.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications:

None required.

Other Duties:

Please note, this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employer for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Systems Engineer

Our team provides support for customer operations to ensure continuity for production.

Partner with the best

You will also support execution of subsea projects. You will be supporting the regional sales and commercial teams, interacting with Customers providing technical expertise during early engagement activities.

  • Have broad knowledge of processes, methods and procedures within project and engineering management.

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

  • Located in Barra da Tijuca, Brazil
  • 30 Hours Per Week - Monday - Friday

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Build software that powers real‑world decisions. As a Software Development Intern, you'll contribute to production web applications across the stack—.NET Core and Python on the back end, React and jQuery on the front end—inside a collaborative culture that prizes innovation, performance, and scalability. Expect structured mentorship, meaningful ownership, and hands‑on experience with projects ranging from spatial data tools to specialized oil & gas solutions—think seismic and well data visualization/manipulation and web‑scraping pipelines—where advanced technology meets complex business challenges. If you're ready to learn fast, ship fast, and see your work make an impact, this is the opportunity.

Tasks:

  • Work with the development team to design, build, and maintain features across company applications using SQL, Java, .NET, Python, and JavaScript—leveraging frameworks such as React and jQuery.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Analytical thinking – ability to break down problems into smaller components.
  • Understanding of algorithms – basic concepts like loops, conditionals, and data structures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is an internship position with a workload of 6 hours per day, totaling 30 hours per week.

Activities may be performed at Katalyst's office or remotely, depending on availability and team coordination.

The work schedule is flexible within regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.), while respecting the 6-hour daily requirement.

Hybrid work model – three remote days and two on-site days per week.

Travel:

This position does not require travel. All work will be conducted in-office or virtually. If participation in an offsite meeting or company event is ever requested, Katalyst will cover or reimburse all related expenses in accordance with company policies and local regulations.

Required Education and Experience

Currently enrolled in a technology-related undergraduate program with at least one year remaining before graduation.

Mais do que uma empresa de engenharia, a SANDECH se posiciona como um parceiro estratégico de seus clientes, unindo experiência técnica, inovação e qualidade. title: AZZAS 2154 | Grupo Soma | Labs | Pessoa Desenvolvedora Mobile Flutter Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Inquietos e Acelerados. Criativos ou Cartesianos. Talentosos e Autodidatas. Artesanais ou Tecnológicos. Não importa: gostamos de diversidade e de quem está aqui para agregar.

Porque GENTE É O QUE SOMA.

Buscamos uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Mobile Flutter Sênior para atuar em um ecossistema de aplicativos digitais iOS e Android, com múltiplos produtos, marcas e integrações, garantindo qualidade técnica, performance e experiência consistente para o usuário final.

Você precisa ser uma pessoa apaixonada por tecnologia, com forte perfil analítico, colaborativo e orientado a aprendizado contínuo, capaz de atuar em arquitetura, sustentação e evolução de apps em produção em um ambiente ágil.

QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicativos móveis em Flutter (Dart) para Android e iOS, desde a concepção até a publicação e manutenção, utilizando boas práticas de arquitetura em camadas, Clean Architecture e princípios SOLID.
  • Implementar telas, fluxos e componentes com atenção a UX, performance e estabilidade, incluindo composição de UIs complexas e widgets customizados.
  • Integrar os apps com APIs REST e serviços de terceiros, garantindo autenticação, tratamento robusto de erros e boa experiência em cenários offline/intermitentes.
  • Atuar na sustentação dos aplicativos: correção de bugs, investigação com logs e Crashlytics, análise de performance e prevenção de regressões.
  • Escrever e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de widgets), garantindo cobertura mínima em fluxos críticos de negócio e UI.
  • Participar de code reviews, refinamentos, estimativas e cerimônias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), contribuindo para decisões técnicas e de produto.
  • Colaborar com times de back-end, produto e design na definição de contratos de API, integrações, Design System e experiências consistentes entre plataformas.
  • Apoiar e evoluir a observabilidade dos apps (Crashlytics, Analytics, Feature Flags, Remote Config) e a experimentação via testes A/B.
  • Contribuir com documentação técnica, boas práticas de desenvolvimento e, quando necessário, participação em etapas técnicas de seleção (entrevistas e avaliações).

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Experiência sólida com Flutter e Dart em produção, incluindo publicação e manutenção de apps em Android e iOS.
  • Forte domínio de recursos modernos da linguagem Dart e programação assíncrona (Futures, Streams, async/await).
  • Experiência prática com arquitetura em camadas, Clean Architecture, separação de responsabilidades e gerenciamento de estado com GetX (lifecycle, .obs, Obx, GetBuilder).
  • Vivência com testes unitários e testes de widgets em Flutter, aplicados a lógica de negócio e componentes de UI.
  • Experiência consumindo APIs REST e integrando com serviços externos, incluindo tratamento de erros e lógica de autenticação.
  • Conhecimento de Git (Bitbucket ou equivalentes), fluxos de pull request e práticas de code review.
  • Vivência com ferramentas da Firebase Suite: Crashlytics, Analytics, Performance, Remote Config e Cloud Messaging.
  • Experiência com CI/CD para mobile/Flutter (ex.: CodeMagic, pipelines de integração e entrega contínua).
  • Noções sólidas de qualidade de código: organização, tratamento de erros, logging estruturado e atenção à performance.
  • +5 anos de experiência prática com Flutter/Dart

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência com múltiplas marcas / white-label apps, mantendo configurações distintas em um ecossistema compartilhado de packages.
  • Vivência com packages interconectados, modularização e gestão de dependências locais (path-based dependencies) e overrides.
  • Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização e animações com Lottie.
  • Experiência com Analytics (AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Insider) e Deep Linking (App Links, Universal Links, URL schemes).
  • Experiência com WebViews (InAppWebView customizada, WebView Flutter) e Push Notifications (Firebase Messaging, Flutter Local Notifications).

Informações adicionais

NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:
Além de trabalhar no maior grupo de moda do Brasil, focado em impulsionar talentos e especializado em fazer gigante, por aqui você também ganha:

Vale Refeição ou Refeitório;

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (apólice coletiva opcional);

Gympass;

Day-off no seu aniversário para você curtir muito;

Formato híbrido, para você trabalhar de onde quiser;

Até 50% de desconto nas nossas marcas;

PLR, de acordo com a nossa política;

Vagas de estacionamento e van no fim do dia, para te levar até o metrô mais próximo;

Cursos, palestras e Trilhas de Desenvolvimento, ao vivo e na nossa plataforma de conteúdo;

Avaliação de desempenho;

Muita visibilidade e exposição positiva, pra você conseguir se conectar com todo mundo sem muita hierarquia.

GRUPO SOMA agora É AZZAS 2154 FASHION & LIFESTYLE

Impulsionar o poder criativo da moda brasileira para o mundo

Somos apaixonados por criar, inovar e transformar o mundo da moda com estilo, propósito e gente boa.

Por aqui, acreditamos no poder das ideias, na força da colaboração e na beleza da diversidade. Valorizamos quem faz, quem pensa diferente, quem aprende todos os dias e quem topa evoluir junto.

title: Senior Front-End and System Engineer
description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical depth, collaboration, and systems thinking shape the future of subsea developments?
 

Would you bring the curiosity, adaptability, and engineering mindset needed to solve complex challenges in early-phase offshore projects?
 

Join our Subsea & Surface Pressure Systems Team

Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market-leading business segments. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward Making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
 

Partner with the best

As a Front-End Subsea Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping early-phase subsea developments. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, support customer engagements, and contribute to concept definition, system architecture, and technical evaluations that guide major offshore projects.
 

As a Senior Front-End and System Engineer - Tendering & FEED, you will be responsible for:

  • Developing subsea field architectures, system layouts, and optimization studies from concept through FEED and into execution.
  • Defining and preparing functional specifications for subsea system components such as trees, controls, manifolds, wellhead connections, and flowlines.
  • Providing system design input for subsea project proposals, equipment packages, and concept definition activities.
  • Supporting R&D initiatives, technology development, and design reviews.


Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have Bachelor's (Engineering, or relevant subject)
  • Have 7+ years of experience with engineering processes, methods, and project execution practices
  • Have knowledge of the Subsea Systems Engineering lifecycle, including NPI, tendering, project engineering, SIT, commissioning, and operations.
  • Have availability to travel internationally for project needs or short-term assignments.


Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - from 7am-4pm
  • Location: RETIC, Ilha do Fundão, Rio de Janeiro.


Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
 

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits
About Us: We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
Join Us: Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you Let's come together and take energy forward.

title: Gerente de TI
description:
POR QUE SER UM VOLTALIEN?

Na Voltalia somos apaixonados pela ideia de um mundo mais sustentável, limpo e inclusivo Acima de tudo buscamos fazer a diferença nas regiões onde atuamos, pois somos uma empresa orientada para nossa missão de melhorar o meio ambiente global, promovendo o desenvolvimento local.

Nossos Valores são: Integridade, Destreza, Empreendedorismo e Espírito de Equipe
. Dentro dessas premissas o respeito nos norteia, por isso, para todas as nossas vagas, valorizamos a diversidade em sua amplitude independente de cor, religião, idade, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero.

Nascemos em 2005 na França e atualmente somos uma empresa de capital aberto na Euronext Paris. Estamos em 20 países, divididos em 4 continentes e oferecemos capacidade operacional global aos nossos clientes.

Atuamos como produtores de energia eólica, solar, hidro, biomassa e soluções de armazenamento. Somos também prestadores de serviços à terceiros como Desenvolvimento, EPC, O&M e Distribuição.

#proudtobeVoltalia

#renewableenergy

O nosso time do TI está buscando um(a) Gerente de TI para apoiar a equipe nas atividades da área, tais como:

O QUE ESPERAR DO SEU DIA A DIA

  • Coordenar as operações de TI locais e fornecer suporte técnico eficiente aos usuários na América Latina.
  • Gerenciar e integrar soluções de TI corporativas, incluindo o ERP Oracle e outras soluções críticas de negócios em nível local e do Grupo.
  • Supervisionar a Tecnologia Operacional (TO) e sua conectividade com os sistemas de TI, promovendo eficiência e segurança nas operações industriais.
  • Garantir a proteção contra ameaças cibernéticas e a conformidade regulatória sob a responsabilidade do nosso Diretor de Segurança da Informação do Grupo.
  • Gestão Financeira: Planejar e controlar o orçamento de TI, garantindo a alocação eficiente de recursos e o alinhamento com a estratégia da empresa.
  • Avaliar e negociar contratos com fornecedores de tecnologia, buscando soluções inovadoras e otimização de custos.
  • Liderar equipes de Operações e Soluções, promovendo o crescimento profissional e o treinamento.
  • Gerenciar a aquisição, manutenção e controle de ativos de TI, incluindo equipamentos, softwares e infraestrutura.
  • Apoiar projetos de inovação tecnológica para aprimorar a eficiência operacional e a competitividade dos negócios.

A ENERGIA QUE PRECISAMOS

  • Bacharelado em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins
  • Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência na área de TI, incluindo ERP, cibersegurança, TO e gestão financeira, sendo 3 anos como gerente ou coordenador
  • Conhecimento avançado em governança de TI, frameworks de cibersegurança e otimização de custos
  • Pós-graduação em Gestão de TI, Segurança da Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas afins
  • Experiência em gestão de custos e investimentos em tecnologia, incluindo otimização de contratos e licenciamento de software
  • Certificações desejáveis em Finanças de TI (como FinOps), Segurança da Informação (CISSP, CISM) ou Gestão de TI (ITIL, PMP ou SCRUM)
  • Conhecimento em IoT, automação industrial e tecnologias emergentes para otimização operacional

A FONTE DE ENERGIA QUE PRECISAMOS

  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança e gestão de pessoas
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação, negociação e relacionamento interpessoal, com habilidade para interagir com stakeholders em todos os níveis em um ambiente multicultural
  • Foco no cliente final e na otimização de recursos
  • Capacidade de planejamento financeiro e tomada de decisões bem fundamentadas
  • Comprometimento e proatividade
  • Abordagem prática com capacidade para lidar com um grande volume de tarefas
  • Trabalho em equipe, Empreendedorismo, Integridade e Inovação são valores requeridos para todos os colaboradores do grupo e, é claro, ser gente boa

COMO VIVEMOS AQUI

Nossa energia de startup está presente no dia a dia, por meio do trabalho em equipe em um ambiente descontraído, criativo e sustentável

Aqui na Voltalia, ousamos em renovar. Buscamos trabalhar de maneira unida e diversa porque acreditamos que, dessa forma, desenhamos nossa essência em cada projeto realizado.

Voltaliens são a nossa maior energia Por isso, pensamos diariamente em nosso desenvolvimento. Temos o foco em soluções porque temos um objetivo em comum: melhorar o nosso ecossistema.

Vamos?

Local de trabalho e modelo de contratação:
Rio de Janeiro (base RJ) — disponibilidade para deslocamentos onshore/offshore e cliente; modelo híbrido.

Equipes diversificadas são equipes melhores Se todos pensarmos da mesma forma, a inovação dificilmente acontece. Por isso, buscamos talentos de diferentes origens, gêneros, idades, raças, orientações sexuais e pessoas com deficiência. Na Siemens, as oportunidades são para todos.

title: Analista Tributário Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado.

Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.

Ser diverso é ser Super

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Objetivo do Cargo
Estamos em busca de um(a)
Analista Tributário(a) Pleno com perfil Tech
, para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, inovador e em processo contínuo de transformação digital da área fiscal.

Esta é
uma vaga afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência (PCD)
— valorizamos diversidade, inclusão e diferentes formas de pensar.

Responsabilidades do Cargo

  • Apuração dos tributos indiretos (ISS, ICMS, IPI) conforme legislação aplicável.
  • Elaborar e transmitir obrigações acessórias (SCANC, SPED Fiscal, GIA, entre outras).
  • Analisar e validar informações fiscais provenientes das Notas Fiscais Eletrônicas (NF-e), incluindo contingências.
  • Monitorar alterações na legislação tributária e avaliar impactos nos processos internos.
  • Prestar atendimento a fiscalizações e auditorias.
  • Acompanhar e compreender os impactos da Reforma Tributária nos processos e obrigações fiscais em geral.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência na área tributária, com foco em tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, IPI, PIS e COFINS) e conhecimento em NFe (xml e regras de validação).
  • Ferramentas:
  • Familiaridade com sistemas ERP, preferencialmente SAP;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Excel, Word e PowerPoint).
  • Atualização contínua por meio de cursos, seminários, treinamentos e estudos autônomos voltados à área tributária.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em Power BI, VBA, Python, SQL ou IA aplicada ao fiscal.
  • Participação em projetos de atualização de Nota Técnica (NT NF-e).
  • Familiaridade com sistemas fiscais (Comply, Mastersaf, PWSAT, Tax One).
  • Inglês (desejável).

Informações adicionais

Na Supergasbras, nós reconhecemos e apoiamos a dedicação dos nossos colaboradores com excelentes benefícios e programas.

Veja o Que Oferecemos Para Você

  • Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistência Médica, Odontológica e Gympass
  • Alimentação de Qualidade: Vale Alimentação e Ticket Refeição
  • Planejar sonhos: Participação nos Resultados e Previdência Privada
  • Família: Licença maternidade/ paternidade estendida
  • Desenvolvimento: Universidade Corporativa e Convênios de Aprendizagem
  • Curtir o Aniversário: Folga no mês do aniversário
  • Outros: Benefícios exclusivos

Ao confirmar a candidatura, você está automaticamente aceitando nossa Política de Privacidade, que encontra-se no link:

SUPERGASBRAS

O que faz a gente ser Super?
Somos uma empresa que valoriza as pessoas e tudo o que elas representam: a energia das ideias, da contribuição, da parceria e da colaboração.

Por isso, nos dedicamos a construir um ambiente de trabalho propício ao desenvolvimento humano e profissional dos nossos colaboradores, sempre incentivando a interação, a participação ativa e o crescimento. Gostamos de quem acrescenta, porque acreditamos que o sucesso vem da soma da energia com a colaboração.

E o que nós fazemos exatamente?
Somos uma empresa do Grupo SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de GLP e uma das principais distribuidoras de gás LP no Brasil, com mais de 75 anos de atuação.

Possuímos o mais moderno parque engarrafador da América Latina e contamos com mais de 20 unidades industriais distribuídas pelo país, de norte a sul.

Nossos mais de 4 mil colaboradores nos enchem de orgulho pelo que somos e pelo que fazemos, levando energia para mais de 10 milhões de famílias brasileiras, alcançando locais onde nenhum outro tipo de energia consegue chegar. Além disso, atendemos mais de 60 mil clientes empresariais, desde pequenos comércios até grandes indústrias, incluindo o agronegócio.

Vem ser Super com a gente

title: Customs & International Freight Manager
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


This role will be responsible for customs operations to ensure compliant, cost-effective, and timely international and domestic movement of goods by managing customs brokerage, documentation, and logistics partnerships. throughout the preparation of the tournament. Will act as the primary liaison for import/export compliance, mitigating risk, resolving transport delays, and optimizing shipping routes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Compliance and Regulations: Ensuring all cargo meets local and international customs laws, regulations, and tax requirements to avoid delays.
  • Logistics and Freight Management: Overseeing transportation, negotiating with carriers/forwarders for optimal rates, and managing shipment tracking.
  • Risk Mitigation and Problem Solving: Proactively addressing issues in the supply chain, such as cargo damage or shipping delays.
  • Operational Support: Coordinating with internal teams (warehouse, procurement) and external partners (ports, agents) to ensure efficient delivery of goods.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Education:Engineering, Administration, Economics, International relations or other related areas
  • Experience: minimum 5 years experience in customs and freight in Brazil.
  • Collaborative mindset, adaptable and willing to work to tight and changing timelines.
  • Proficient in analytical thinking and data skills.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude, patience, persistence, and determination.
  • Experience working in a multi-cultural, multi-national environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

title: Customs & International Freight Manager
description:
Customs & International Freight Manager


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


This role will be responsible for customs operations to ensure compliant, cost-effective, and timely international and domestic movement of goods by managing customs brokerage, documentation, and logistics partnerships. throughout the preparation of the tournament. Will act as the primary liaison for import/export compliance, mitigating risk, resolving transport delays, and optimizing shipping routes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Compliance and Regulations: Ensuring all cargo meets local and international customs laws, regulations, and tax requirements to avoid delays.
  • Logistics and Freight Management: Overseeing transportation, negotiating with carriers/forwarders for optimal rates, and managing shipment tracking.
  • Risk Mitigation and Problem Solving: Proactively addressing issues in the supply chain, such as cargo damage or shipping delays.
  • Operational Support: Coordinating with internal teams (warehouse, procurement) and external partners (ports, agents) to ensure efficient delivery of goods.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Education:Engineering, Administration, Economics, International relations or other related areas
  • Experience: minimum 5 years experience in customs and freight in Brazil.
  • Collaborative mindset, adaptable and willing to work to tight and changing timelines.
  • Proficient in analytical thinking and data skills.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude, patience, persistence, and determination.
  • Experience working in a multi-cultural, multi-national environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

title: Engineer II, Sustainability
description:
Description

The Engineer II, Sustainability will be responsible for supporting the activities of the Global Sustainability team related to GHG emissions from marine and offshore vessels/assets as well as activities associated with other sustainability-related projects. These include but are not limited to benchmarking, statistical analysis, and sustainability reporting.

What You Will Do:

  • Maintain a solid understanding of emerging regulatory framework related to GHG emissions and waste streams
  • Support the department's different projects, services, and other activities.
  • Interact with clients to perform services offered by the Global Sustainability team and identify/resolve problems with technical expertise.
  • Establish and manage client projects.
  • May update and inform the Global Sustainability team on regulatory changes and their impact on ABS business.
  • May conduct seminars and workshops related to the environmental performance of marine vessels and offshore units.
  • Support the associated service delivery across all geographic locations of Sustainability (Houston, Athens, Copenhagen, Singapore).
  • May contribute to authoring ABS publications and thought leadership documents. 
  • Maintain awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate
  • May attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends
  • Communicates the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure the needs of the clients will be met
  • May identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company's CRM
  • Works as a team member within the group, but may work autonomously most of the time

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Requires a BSc in Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with a focus on environmental performance.
  • MSc degree preferred.
  • Requires a minimum of four (4) years of related engineering experience in a recognized research university, research institute, shipyard, design/consulting office, shipping/oil company, or a classification society. 
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience with either marine or offshore applications.
  • Knowledge of GHG regulations, impacts, and technology transition.
  • Experience with programming and advanced use of MS Office.
  • Must be capable of presenting and working with clients
  • Knowledge of related technical disciplines required
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills)
  • Ability to work well with others
  • Excellent communication skills (oral & written), enabling effective communication at multiple levels
  • Strong commitment to ethical business practices, in full accordance with relevant corporate policies
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy. 
  • Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Reporting Relationships:

Reports to a Manager, Director, or Executive level position.

Quer trabalhar na maior plataforma de saúde do MUNDO?

  • Imprescindível experiência com utilização de CRM;

  • Habilidades em organização e gerenciamento do tempo;
  • Paixão por vendas;
  • Perfil adaptável a mudanças;
  • Motivado por metas;
  • Com pensamento de protagonista e que seja curioso e esteja disposto a aprender sempre.

Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia, startup, SaaS ou vendas complexas;
  • Conhecimento e experiência com a técnica Spin Selling;
  • Curso superior completo;
  • Inglês avançado.

Aqui na DOC, valorizamos e celebramos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Estamos empenhados em atrair talentos diversos, sem importar gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou condição física. Estamos comprometidos em construir uma equipe inclusiva e acolhedora, onde cada indivíduo possa fazer bonito, contribuindo com seu melhor.

  • Jornada de trabalho é de segunda à sexta, das 9h às 18h - Híbrido no Rio (2x presenciais) ou remotas

title: Pedreiro/Oficial de Manutenção
description:
Quem somos?

-  Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?

Um Oficial de Manutenção Pedreiro experiente, responsável pela execução autônoma de atividades de construção, conservação e reparo. Este profissional terá um papel crucial na manutenção da integridade estrutural e estética de nossos ativos.

Dia a Dia:

O profissional irá realizar tarefas que exigem conhecimento técnico e autonomia, incluindo:

  • Alvenaria e Revestimentos: Assentar tijolos, blocos e construir/reformar instalações em alvenaria.
    Assentar pisos, azulejos e outros revestimentos. Executar emboço e reboco de paredes, garantindo acabamento de qualidade.
  • Reparos Estruturais e Civis: Realizar manutenção e reparos em telhados, lajes, calçadas e outras estruturas.
  • Manutenções Complementares: Executar pequenas tarefas de manutenção hidráulica e elétrica básica (reparos em sistemas de água, instalações elétricas simples), conforme a necessidade.
  • Preparo de Materiais: Preparar argamassas, concretos e outros materiais de construção na dosagem correta.
  • Segurança e Organização: Montar e desmontar andaimes, seguindo rigorosas normas de segurança (NR-35 - Trabalho em Altura). Utilizar todos os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e seguir as normas de segurança, inclusive em espaços confinados.

Local de trabalho: Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar. Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro

Horário: 8h as 18h de segunda a quinta-feira | 8h as 17h na sexta-feira

Requirements

O que precisamos que você tenha:

  • 2º grau completo.
  • Escolaridade: Ensino Médio Completo.
  • Experiência/Formação: Experiência comprovada na área ou qualificação profissional específica (Ex: Curso profissionalizante do SENAI).
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento aprofundado na área e domínio no uso de ferramentas e equipamentos específicos do ofício.

O que vamos amar se você tiver:

  • Proatividade e Iniciativa: Capacidade de antecipar problemas e buscar soluções de forma autônoma.
  • Assiduidade: Comprometimento com horários e prazos.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de interagir e colaborar efetivamente com outros setores de manutenção.

Benefits

Benefícios

  • Alimentação: VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Serviços
description:
Description

Resumo do cargo: 

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão: 

1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sistemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);

2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;

3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;

4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

6) Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);

7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);

8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;

9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é: 

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará: 

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;

  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);

  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;

  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;

  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;

  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;

  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;

  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;

  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;

  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Responsável pela operação e monitoramento dos painéis na Sala de Controle referente às Operações de Carga em geral;
  • Responsável por executar o plano de carregamento dos tanques e o plano de descarregamento para as operações de Offload, bem como a consolidação da carga, mantendo as condições de estabilidade do ativo;
  • Manter o Superintendente de Marinha e o Supervisor de Carga informados sobre todas as atividades marítimas, tais como operações de carga, transferência de carga, operações de lastro, etc;
  • Responsável pela manutenção dos procedimentos operacionais e Check lists da abrangência ao controle de carga.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos:

  • Formação técnica em áreas correlatas à operação marítima, como Técnico em Marinha Mercante ou Operações Offshore, com conhecimento aplicado em estabilidade de navios e controle de carga;
  • Conhecimento das normas ISM, MARPOL e SOLAS, além de familiaridade com os procedimentos de HSEQ e segurança operacional;
  • Capacidade de operar painéis de controle e sistemas de lastro com autonomia, utilizando ferramentas digitais e checklists operacionais;
  • Inglês técnico intermediário para comunicação operacional e interpretação de instruções técnicas.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?
Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas

Dica:
Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Somos um restaurante de cozinha oriental que traz o conceito japa fusion. Fazemos parte do Grupo Trigo, uma holding 100% brasileira, que nasceu com o propósito de democratizar a boa culinária. Além do Gurumê, o Grupo Trigo conta também com as marcas Spoleto, Koni e LeBonton nesta empreitada

O Gurumê foi idealizado com base em quatro grandes pilares: Ambiente; Serviço; Preço e Qualidade. Em Fevereiro de 2018, abrimos nosso quarto restaurante no Rio Design Barra. Em 2019 inauguramos nossa quinta casa no Shopping Rio Sul e no finalzinho de 2020, ainda no bairro de Botafogo, nos reinventamos com uma loja 100% Delivery, o Gurumê em Casa.

Ta achando que acabou? Nada disso... O Gurumê está cada vez maior, e com isso apresentamos a nossa mais nova casa, inaugurada em Maio de 2023: Gurumê Rio Design Leblon.
